summary: Government portal (GOI) additions and related fixes

details.purpose: Add a minimal Government of India dashboard with simple auth and a protected dashboard endpoint that aggregates patient data.

POST /api/gov/login.description: Authenticate using fixed GOV credentials from env vars

GET /api/gov/dashboard.description: Protected endpoint returning aggregated patient data

bug_fixes: Fixed token parsing in verifyGovToken middleware (used to split header into characters).

testing_instructions.1_copy_env: Copy .env.example to .env and set DB and GOV credentials
testing_instructions.2_start: cd server && npm install && npm run dev

next_steps: Migrate GOV credentials to a GovernmentOfficial DB model
Add frontend GOI login + dashboard UI
Add more aggregation endpoints and filters
Add audit logging and role-based RBAC if required
